diff --git a/openlibrary/plugins/openlibrary/tests/test_lists.py b/openlibrary/plugins/openlibrary/tests/test_lists.py
index a282c36..baf6369 100644
--- a/openlibrary/plugins/openlibrary/tests/test_lists.py
+++ b/openlibrary/plugins/openlibrary/tests/test_lists.py
@@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
 from openlibrary.plugins.openlibrary import lists
+import web
 
 
 def test_process_seeds():
@@ -11,3 +12,34 @@ def test_process_seeds():
     assert f({"key": "/books/OL1M"}) == {"key": "/books/OL1M"}
     assert f("/subjects/love") == "subject:love"
     assert f("subject:love") == "subject:love"
+
+
+def test_list_record_uses_form_body_without_query(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        lists.web,
+        'data',
+        lambda: b'name=Body+name&name=Second&description=From+body&seeds--0--key=%2Fworks%2FOL1W&seeds--1--key=&seeds--2--other=bad&seeds--3=invalid',
+    )
+
+    def no_query(**defaults):
+        raise AssertionError('body input must not read merged query parameters')
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(lists.web, 'input', no_query)
+    record = lists.ListRecord.from_input()
+    assert record.key is None
+    assert record.name == 'Body name'
+    assert record.description == 'From body'
+    assert record.seeds == [{'key': '/works/OL1W'}]
+
+
+def test_list_record_reads_query_when_body_empty(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(lists.web, 'data', lambda: b'')
+
+    def query(**defaults):
+        assert defaults == dict(key=None, name='', description='', seeds=[])
+        return web.storage(defaults | {'name': 'Query name', 'seeds--0--key': '/works/OL2W'})
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(lists.web, 'input', query)
+    record = lists.ListRecord.from_input()
+    assert record.name == 'Query name'
+    assert record.seeds == [{'key': '/works/OL2W'}]
